NewsArticle.Title: Search the Aisling Library
NewsArticle.Content:
Aisling library of 500+ documents of 400+ works is now search-enabled.
Find precisely what you're looking for, from Draco's teeth to the intrigue of Loures, from theories of magic to politics to trap-making.
Art, biography, history, literature, lore, and philosophy at your command. [www.DarkAges.com/library/temuair](http://www.darkages.com/library/temuair)
It is an honor to maintain the library of inspired works and to offer inspiration and entertainment in Dark Ages.
Volunteers for help for a better Aisling Library search are welcome.
Dave Kennerly
Game Director
and Librarian
